title: Win/loss by competitor
summary: Reads your closed HubSpot deals and reports win rate, revenue and the top won and lost reasons against each competitor.
trigger: Manual run (deal property name, lookback in days)
setup: Import the template and connect HubSpot.
Find the deal property that records the competitor (for example `competitor`). Use its internal name from HubSpot Settings > Properties.
Run it with that property name and how many days to look back (default 90).
Edit the `win-loss-analyst` agent to change how the findings are written up.
notes: The competitor comes from one deal property you name. Deals where it is empty are counted under "No competitor recorded"; if it is empty on every deal, the report says so instead of guessing.
Won and lost reasons come from HubSpot's `closed_won_reason` and `closed_lost_reason` properties.
Reads up to 1,000 closed deals per run.
